R5.objective: Know which policies apply to you and confirm you have read them.
R5.task: Read each required policy and submit the acknowledgement form.
R5.checklist: Policy acknowledgement submitted within 1 day of joining
R5.quiz_question: How soon must you acknowledge the required policies?

R4.objective: Recognise common security risks and report them the right way.
R4.task: Complete the security awareness training and its short check.
R4.checklist: Security awareness training done within 2 days of joining
R4.quiz_question: What should you do with a suspicious login request?
quiz_options: Click the link to check it

R1.objective: Set up the approved workstation and a sandbox you can safely build and test in.
R1.task: Install the approved image, request sandbox access and run the sample build.
R1.checklist: Workstation and sandbox ready within 2 days of joining

R2.objective: Apply the required secure coding practices when writing and reviewing code.
R2.task: Finish the secure coding course, then fix the seeded issues in the sandbox exercise.
R2.checklist: Secure coding training completed within 5 days of joining
R2.quiz_question: Which modules come before secure coding?

R3.objective: Use the approved branch, review and merge workflow on a real change.
R3.task: Make a small change on a branch, get it reviewed and merge it by the workflow.
R3.checklist: Repository workflow demonstrated within 6 days of joining
quiz_options: Demonstrating it on a reviewed change

R6.objective: Show you are ready to work independently after onboarding.
R6.task: Take the final assessment once every other module is complete.
R6.checklist: Final assessment taken within 7 days of joining
R6.quiz_question: When can the final assessment be taken?
